home.hero_desc: Reduce equipment downtime by up to 40%. AI fault diagnosis, automated warranty tracking, QR maintenance checks, and smart supplier management — all in one platform.
home.trusted_by: Trusted by gyms across the UK
home.qr_desc: Every machine gets a QR code. Staff scan it with their phone and instantly get two options:
home.qr_fault_desc: Take a photo, describe the issue. AI analyses everything and returns a full triage — diagnosis, severity, repair steps, and estimated time — right on the phone.
home.qr_check_desc: Machine-specific checklists load automatically. Check items off, add notes, submit — and it’s instantly recorded on the desktop dashboard.
home.step1_desc: Scan a QR code or use the dashboard. AI diagnoses the issue instantly. Get step-by-step repair instructions and decide if you can fix it yourself or need an engineer.
home.step2_desc: Every fault is tracked with full history, photos, AI triage, supplier references, and purchase orders. Warranty and contract coverage checked automatically.
home.step3_desc: Automated check sheets, AI audit reports, risk assessments, expiry alerts, and operational analytics keep your gym safe, compliant, and cost-efficient.
home.platform_title: Everything You Need in One Platform
home.platform_desc: From AI-powered diagnosis to QR scanning, warranty tracking to gym layout design — 15 features, one subscription.
home.feat_ai_desc: Describe the problem, get instant step-by-step repair guidance powered by GPT-4o. Fix issues in-house without waiting for an engineer.
home.feat_qr_desc: Per-equipment QR codes. Staff scan with their phone to report faults (with photo) or complete maintenance checks — syncs instantly to the dashboard.
home.feat_mobile_desc: After reporting a fault via QR scan, AI Vision analyses the photo and description. Get severity, diagnosis, repair steps, and estimated time — right on your phone.
home.feat_warranty_desc: Every machine shows coverage status when logging faults. No coverage? You're prompted to create a purchase order before the engineer is called out.
home.feat_alerts_desc: Automated alerts when warranties or contracts are expiring. One-click sends bundled reminder emails to you and the supplier.
home.feat_risk_desc: Upload gym photos for automated PLR, PSR, and RRN scoring. Print-ready PDF reports for compliance and insurance.
home.feat_audit_desc: Generate detailed equipment audits with condition ratings, safety flags, and replacement timelines. Export as PDF.
home.feat_faults_desc: Log faults with AI triage, track status from open to resolved. Full history, photos, attachments, and supplier references.
home.feat_po_desc: Create POs directly from a fault with line items, VAT calculations, and email them to suppliers. Linked to fault records.
home.feat_checks_desc: 8 pre-built equipment categories plus custom templates. Complete via desktop or QR scan on mobile. Schedule daily, weekly, and monthly tasks.
home.feat_layout_desc: Import your floor plan, then place equipment with sub-millimetre precision. Drag, rotate, resize, and number machines with a colour-coded legend.
home.feat_reports_desc: Faults by severity, equipment, and supplier. PO spend tracking. Resolution time analytics, self-fix rates, and trend analysis.
home.feat_multiuser_desc: Owner, Manager, and Staff roles. Invite team via company code. Everyone sees the same live data across all sites.
home.feat_supplier_desc: Suppliers get their own portal to manage escalated cases. Open API for integration with your existing supplier systems.
home.feat_whitelabel_desc: Custom branding, logo, and colours. Your clients see your brand, not ours. Perfect for franchise operators and consultants.
home.coverage_title: Never Get Caught Out on an Uncovered Callout
home.coverage_desc_1: Every time a fault is logged, GymAxis AI checks the machine's warranty and contract status. If it's not covered, you're prompted to create a purchase order — before the supplier even picks up the phone.
home.coverage_desc_2: Automated expiry alerts email both you and the supplier when coverage is about to end, so you can renew or renegotiate before it's too late.
home.coverage_warranty_desc: Machine covered — proceed with engineer callout. No PO required.
home.coverage_not_desc: Machine warranty expired. Create a purchase order before the callout.
home.coverage_alert_desc: Get notified 30, 7, and 1 day before coverage expires. Suppliers get reminded too.
home.coverage_email_desc: One email per supplier with all their expiring machines. No inbox spam.
home.roi_title: Reduce Engineer Callouts by Up to 40%
home.roi_desc: Fix more issues in-house with AI-guided repair steps. Only escalate when truly necessary. Track every pound spent on POs and engineer time.
home.roi_1: Track self-fix rates vs engineer callouts over time
home.roi_2: Warranty & contract status checked on every fault
home.roi_3: AI triage resolves issues before they escalate

about_page.title: Experts in Gym Equipment Maintenance
about_page.subtitle: We're on a mission to transform gym maintenance with AI-powered solutions that save time, reduce costs, and keep equipment running smoothly.
about_page.mission_desc: Empower fitness operators to reduce downtime, cut maintenance costs, and deliver better member experiences through intelligent automation.
about_page.expertise_desc: Built by industry professionals with decades of combined experience in gym equipment maintenance, operations, and AI technology.
about_page.trust_desc: Serving gyms, leisure centres, councils, and fitness chains across the UK and internationally. Proven results in cost reduction and efficiency.
about_page.story_p1: GymAxis AI was founded to solve a critical problem in the fitness industry: equipment downtime and excessive maintenance costs. Traditional maintenance approaches are reactive, expensive, and rely heavily on external engineers.
about_page.story_p2: We saw an opportunity to leverage AI technology to empower gym staff with instant diagnostic support, comprehensive audit capabilities, and preventative maintenance guidance. Our platform puts expert knowledge at your fingertips, reducing the need for costly callouts while improving equipment reliability.
about_page.story_p3: Today, we work with fitness operators of all sizes - from single-site independent gyms to large leisure centre chains. Our focus remains the same: delivering practical, cost-effective solutions that make a real difference to your operations.
about_page.efficiency_desc: Every feature is designed to save you time and money. No bloat, no complexity - just practical solutions that work.
about_page.reliability_desc: Our AI models are trained on real-world equipment data. We provide accurate, actionable guidance you can trust.
about_page.support_desc: We're here when you need us. Fast response times, expert guidance, and a genuine commitment to your success.
about_page.innovation_desc: We're constantly improving our platform based on user feedback and the latest AI technology advancements.
